notes: Most misleading image in the set: a customer comparing it against the 5 cm rung would conclude 15 cm is the SHORTER option. Must not ship. LADDER GRADED AS A SET. Rendered tab overhang measured against the steel rule inside each frame (tab tip minus fly/body edge): 5cm -> ~5.7, 5.5cm -> ~5.2, 6cm -> ~6.2, 6.5cm -> ~5.9, 7cm -> ~4.4, 13cm -> ~10.2, 15cm -> ~4.0. Required order 5<5.5<6<6.5<7<13<15; actual order 15<7<5.5<5<6.5<6<13. The series is severely NON-MONOTONIC after the one permitted retry (this is attempt 2). ROOT CAUSE: all seven tech-pack drawings are 221x221 px and the line art is IDENTICAL across rungs - only a red text annotation ("5cm" / "13cm" / "15cm") differs. The blueprint encodes tab length as text, not geometry, and the locked prompt forbids rendering annotation text, so the attached reference supplies zero visual signal for the dimension. No third attempt taken, per directive.
